open_items: ESTAT list_dataflows timeout pattern: fifteenth episode, cycle 312, resolved by cycle 313, clean through cycle 313. Live recheck against ec.europa.eu directly returned HTTP 200 in 31.1s, confirming provider-side slowness under load rather than an outage. Like all fourteen priors, resolved within one cycle. Standing recommendation (raise deadline, stream listing, or cache parsed result) remains open as a code-change-scope fix. Watch for a sixteenth episode; escalate if a future episode spans more than one cycle.
